mapper.insert: insert into sys_unlock_record (user_id, episode_id, work_id, unlock_type, amount, ad_task_id, created_at) select #{userId}, #{episodeId}, #{workId}, #{unlockType}, #{amount}, #{adTaskId}, now() from dual where not exists ( select 1 from sys_unlock_record r where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.episode_id = #{episodeId} )
